dimensions.assessment: Affects political committees and persons making electioneering communications who file reports with the FEC.
dimensions.evidence: requires the Federal Election Commission (FEC) to make electronic filing mandatory for political committees and others required to file

dimensions.assessment: Implements minor administrative and procedural modernization for campaign finance filings and payment methods.
dimensions.evidence: allows political committees to make disbursements by methods other than check

dimensions.assessment: No significant federal fiscal or economic implications stated.
Amends the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 to broaden electronic filing types and remove payment restrictions.
Permanent statutory change to federal campaign finance compliance rules.

missing_information: Estimated administrative cost savings for the FEC or filing entities
importance_detail.rationale: This bill expands mandatory FEC electronic filing requirements to include electioneering communication reports and permits political committees to make disbursements by methods other than checks.
